definition: A function that converts a vector of raw scores into a probability distribution, where all values are positive and sum to one.
details: Softmax is used throughout neural networks, including in attention mechanisms to normalize attention scores and in output layers to convert logits into a probability distribution over possible tokens or classes.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. In plain words: A function that converts a vector of raw scores into a probability distribution, where all values are positive and sum to one. Here is how it actually plays out: Softmax is used throughout neural networks, including in attention mechanisms to normalize attention scores and in output layers to convert logits into a probability distribution over possible tokens or classes. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Softmax Function.
